entries.45224ac6c98ca179: Based on its corporate message “For Diverse Well-being,” it is working to realize its long-term management vision “NSK2030,” formulated in 2022. It positions fiscal 2025 through fiscal 2027 as Phase 2 (policy implementation period) of this vision, promotes the medium-term management plan “Chukei 2027” as its implementation plan, and sets out as business strategies “materializing priority areas and creating new businesses,” “reviewing the earnings structure and optimizing facilities,” and “mutual growth of people and organization and pursuit of social and environmental value.” It positions the supply of high value-added products as its Solution Business and the supply of materials for daily necessities with cost competitiveness as its Primary Business, and aims for sustainable growth through a business structure that includes its by-products business. The target figures of the medium-term management plan are not transcribed here, as they include forward-looking matters.

entries.e958a4ac146625e1: It has a business foundation in having been the first in Japan, in 1948, to begin processing corn by the wet milling method. It is developing functional saccharides that contribute to more advanced and diversified foods and to the preventive health area, and is working to build markets for “Megarinku,” a new slowly digestible saccharide product with gentle digestion and absorption, and “Starcross 70PPi,” a material containing 70% starch that helps reduce the use of petroleum-derived resins.
